reality.title: Why spreadsheets fail multi-million dollar construction projects
reality.description: On construction sites, project data lives in disconnected spreadsheets that are reconciled only during heated billing disputes. Our unified engine binds physical site reality directly to the approved contract.
reality.chaos1Desc: QS estimator revises Version 4 in head office while site supervisor oversees casting with printed Version 2 unit rates.
reality.chaos2Desc: Foremen submit daily progress estimates via chat messages without timestamped geotagged photos or contract quantity bounds.
reality.chaos3Desc: Project engineers spend 72 hours copy-pasting numbers to produce weekly physical/financial progress PDFs before owner meetings.
reality.ledger1Desc: Estimators, supervisors, and project managers share one authoritative budget snapshot. Contract addenda create tracked new baselines.
reality.ledger2Desc: Foremen report daily volume and photo evidence via Telegram Mini App on remote 3G cellular connections without 200MB apps.
reality.ledger3Desc: Physical progress, earned financial value, and deviation curves generate directly from verified ledger entries with zero manual math.

pillars.title: Five core pillars built for construction reality
pillars.description: Engineered around Indonesian and international construction standards, contract administration frameworks, and rigorous site operations.
pillars.p1Title: XLSX RAB / BoQ Ingestion & Flexible WBS
pillars.p1Desc: Upload vendor or client spreadsheets with variable column layouts. Interactive column mapping and validation catch duplicate codes, zero denominators, and unit mismatches before committing to a draft.
pillars.p2Desc: Site foremen report completed quantities, concrete pour volumes, and geotagged evidence photos via Telegram. No 200 MB app downloads, works reliably on remote site 3G, and eliminates WhatsApp screenshot chaos.
pillars.p3Desc: Strict separation of duties between reporter, site supervisor, project manager, and supervisory consultant (MK). Every approval is idempotent and writes an immutable ledger entry with timestamp and user ID.
pillars.p4Desc: Generate official weekly progress reports and time schedule S-curves from the immutable database snapshot. Export pixel-perfect print-ready PDFs and Excel documents with standardized corporate headers and signatories.
pillars.p5Desc: Process contract variations (pekerjaan tambah/kurang) without corrupting previous historical reports. Past published weekly reports remain 100% reproducible against the baseline active at publication date.

integrity.title: Built like enterprise infrastructure, not a fragile spreadsheet
integrity.description: We treat construction finances and volume claims with the exact mathematical rigor demanded by banking ledgers.
integrity.f1Desc: All contract values, quantities, and progress weights use exact decimal arithmetic. Zero floating-point drift or calculation rounding discrepancies.
integrity.f2Desc: Strict company-level and project-level authorization filters on every query. Negative security tests prove tenant data can never leak to competitors.
integrity.f3Desc: State-of-the-art password hashing, HttpOnly secure cookies, CSRF protection, and instant revocation of lost site devices.
integrity.f4Desc: Published weekly documents and approvals are committed as immutable snapshots with cryptographic checksums.

faq.title: Straight answers for site engineers and directors
faq.q1: Can we import our existing Excel RAB without reformatting?
faq.a1: Yes. Our importer provides an interactive mapping step where you match your existing column headers (Item Code, Description, Volume, Unit, Unit Rate) and preview the hierarchy before approving the draft baseline.
faq.q2: Do site foremen (mandor) need to install an app?
faq.a2: No. Site foremen and field supervisors access their daily reporting queue via the Telegram Mini App directly inside Telegram. It loads in seconds, uses minimal cellular data, and works reliably on remote site 3G.
faq.q3: How are contract addenda (pekerjaan tambah/kurang) handled?
faq.a3: Addenda are created as new versioned budget drafts with explicit cutover dates. Once approved, all future progress evaluates against the new contract volume, while every historical report already published remains locked and reproducible.
faq.q4: Does the weekly progress value represent cash outflow?
faq.a4: No. In accordance with standard construction contract administration, the weekly financial progress value represents the earned value of verified physical volume multiplied by contract unit rate, kept strictly separate from actual accounting cash expenses.
faq.q5: Can our subcontractors or competitors access our project data?
faq.a5: Never. Our platform uses strict company-level and project-level authorization boundaries enforced in the Go backend. Default-deny security and automated negative tests verify complete isolation across tenants.
